title: 회식 정하기: 좋긴 한데요, 이건 어때요?
objective: Disagree politely with -긴 한데요, give a reason with -았/었더니, and suggest with -는 건 어떨까요?
summary: Two coworkers plan a team dinner, and one disagrees politely.
setting: An office break room. Minsu and Jia are planning this month's team dinner (회식).

task.title: Practise disagreeing politely
task.line: Read each item, then choose, fill in, reorder, or write the Korean as the instruction says.

words.meaning: it is (true), but... — agree a little first, then say your problem
words.example: 그 카페가 분위기는 좋긴 한데요, 좀 멀어요.
words.exampleMeaning: That café does have a nice mood, but it's a bit far.

words.meaning: that might be a bit hard (a polite way to say no)
words.example: 토요일 아침은 좀 어려울 것 같아요.
words.exampleMeaning: Saturday morning might be a bit hard for me.

words.meaning: I did/tried ..., and then (this happened) — use your own past experience as a reason
words.example: 아침을 안 먹었더니 배가 너무 고파요.
words.exampleMeaning: I skipped breakfast, and now I'm really hungry.

words.example: 꽃 대신 케이크를 사는 건 어떨까요?
words.exampleMeaning: How about buying a cake instead of flowers?

words.meaning: now that I hear it, you're right (accepting the other person's point)
words.example: 아, 듣고 보니 그렇네요. 제가 그 생각을 못 했어요.
words.exampleMeaning: Oh, now that you say it, you're right. I didn't think of that.

dialogue.korean: 이번 회식은 금요일 저녁에 하는 게 어때요?
dialogue.meaning: How about having this team dinner on Friday evening?

dialogue.korean: 좋은 생각이긴 한데요, 금요일은 좀 어려울 것 같아요.
dialogue.meaning: It's a good idea, but Friday might be a bit difficult.
Why? The next day is a day off, so it's easy, right?

dialogue.korean: 지난번에 금요일에 했더니 절반 가까이 못 왔어요. 다들 주말 약속이 있어서요.
dialogue.meaning: Last time we did it on a Friday, almost half couldn't come. Everyone had weekend plans.

dialogue.korean: 듣고 보니 그렇네요. 지아 씨는 어떻게 생각해요?
dialogue.meaning: Now that you say it, you're right. What do you think, Jia?

dialogue.korean: 제 생각에는 수요일 점심에 조용한 한식집에서 하는 건 어떨까요? 작년에 점심에 했더니 반응이 좋았어요.
dialogue.meaning: In my opinion, how about doing it at a quiet Korean restaurant on Wednesday at lunch? We did it at lunch last year, and people liked it.

dialogue.korean: 점심이요? 그것도 괜찮겠네요. 팀원들한테 한번 물어볼게요.
dialogue.meaning: Lunch? That could work too. I'll ask the team.

exercises: Choose the softer way to disagree (A or B): 동료: "회의를 아침 8시에 할까요?" A. 아니요, 너무 일러요. B. 좋긴 한데요, 8시는 좀 이를 것 같아요.
Fill in the blank with -았/었더니: ① (마시다) 어제 저녁에 커피를 ____ 잠을 못 잤어요. ② (운동하다) 주말에 오래 ____ 다리가 아파요.
Put the words in order to make a soft suggestion: 어떨까요? / 버스를 / 건 / 타는
Answer in Korean using the dialogue: 지아 씨는 회식을 언제, 어디에서 하자고 했어요?
answers: 수요일 점심에 조용한 한식집에서 하자고 했어요. (수요일 점심에 조용한 한식집에서요.)
